name: Executive brief
description: Summarize outcomes, decisions, and issues that need leadership attention.

sections.title: Executive takeaway
sections.instruction: Give the main outcome and its stated impact in a short paragraph. Cite the supplied source tags for key claims

sections.title: Decisions and impact
sections.instruction: List decisions, their business impact, and any stated measures. Distinguish confirmed decisions from proposals and cite the supplied source tags

sections.title: Risks and escalations
sections.instruction: List material risks, blockers, and requests for escalation. State who raised them when the source supports it and preserve their uncertainty

sections.title: Action items
sections.instruction: List commitments and leadership follow-ups. Include owners and due dates only when explicitly stated, and copy the supplied source tag beside each task
sections.item_format: - Task in one sentence. Owner: name or Unassigned; Due: date or Not specified
